env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos build -o $WORK/good$GOEXE ./good
! logos build -o $WORK/bad$GOEXE ./bad
stderr -count=2 'correctness::result_before_error_check'

logos build -o $WORK/goodalias$GOEXE ./goodalias
! logos build -o $WORK/badalias$GOEXE ./badalias
stderr -count=5 'correctness::result_before_error_check'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/ef

go 1.27

-- lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type C struct{}

func Fetch() (int, error) {
	return 1, nil
}

func (C) Get() (int, error) {
	return 2, nil
}

-- bad/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/ef/lib"

func main() {
	n, err := lib.Fetch()
	println(n, err)
	var c lib.C
	m, err2 := c.Get()
	println(m, err2)
}

-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"strconv"

	"example.com/ef/lib"
)

func main() {
	n, err := lib.Fetch()
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	var c lib.C
	m, err2 := c.Get()
	if err2 != nil {
		return
	}
	k, err3 := strconv.Atoi("7")
	println(n, m, k, err3)
}

-- libscroll/lib.📜 --
package libscroll

func Fetch() (int, error) {
	return 1, nil
}

-- liblightning/lib.⚡ --
package liblightning

func Fetch() (int, error) {
	return 2, nil
}

-- libgopher/lib.ʕ◔ϖ◔ʔ --
package libgopher

func Fetch() (int, error) {
	return 3, nil
}

-- libvs/lib.⚡️ --
package libvs

type C struct{}

func Fetch() (int, error) {
	return 4, nil
}

func (C) Get() (int, error) {
	return 5, nil
}

-- badalias/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/ef/libgopher"
	"example.com/ef/liblightning"
	"example.com/ef/libscroll"
	"example.com/ef/libvs"
)

func main() {
	a, e1 := libscroll.Fetch()
	println(a, e1)
	b, e2 := liblightning.Fetch()
	println(b, e2)
	c, e3 := libgopher.Fetch()
	println(c, e3)
	d, e4 := libvs.Fetch()
	println(d, e4)
	var v libvs.C
	f, e5 := v.Get()
	println(f, e5)
}

-- goodalias/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/ef/libgopher"
	"example.com/ef/liblightning"
	"example.com/ef/libscroll"
	"example.com/ef/libvs"
)

func main() {
	a, e1 := libscroll.Fetch()
	if e1 != nil {
		return
	}
	b, e2 := liblightning.Fetch()
	if e2 != nil {
		return
	}
	c, e3 := libgopher.Fetch()
	if e3 != nil {
		return
	}
	d, e4 := libvs.Fetch()
	if e4 != nil {
		return
	}
	var v libvs.C
	f, e5 := v.Get()
	if e5 != nil {
		return
	}
	println(a, b, c, d, f)
}
